g.text: New attribute: from a free question to a category definition shared with all hospitals
Add free question in review step
no criticality, never in a template,
Visible to ALL hospitals as additional information
not filtered, not judged, never auto-asked
New assessments: major UNKNOWN on the hospital side
-> PURCHASER question; BD value already known -> BD not asked
Open assessments pick it up next round;
rounds already judged keep their stored definition
Correct labels / synonyms if needed (neutral-label check);
set CRITICALITY (e.g. major) and comparison rule;
Merge into an APPROVED attribute of the same type:
every value validated first (422 lists misfits, nothing moves);
facts re-added under the target key, old ones superseded;
questions take the target key; merged_into set, DEPRECATED
attribute DEPRECATED; facts kept for audit;
Validate against the core model, store,
